code:
SECRET_HINTS = ("PASSWORD", "PASSWD", "SECRET", "TOKEN", "_KEY", "PRIVATE")
SAFE_ENV_KEYS = ("PATH", "LANG", "TZ", "VERSION", "PYTHONUNBUFFERED",
                 "NODE_ENV", "JAVA_HOME", "LC_ALL")


def rule_config_external(dockerfile):
    bad = []
    for line in dockerfile:
        s = line.strip()
        if not s.startswith("ENV "):
            continue
        kv = s[4:].strip()
        key = kv.split("=")[0].strip()
        if key.upper() in SAFE_ENV_KEYS:
            continue
        bad.append(s)
    return not bad, bad


def rule_no_secret(dockerfile):
    bad = []
    for line in dockerfile:
        s = line.strip().upper()
        if s.startswith("COPY ") and ".ENV" in s:
            bad.append(line.strip())
            continue
        if s.startswith("ENV ") or s.startswith("ARG "):
            if any(h in s for h in SECRET_HINTS):
                bad.append(line.strip())
    return not bad, bad


def check(project):
    df = project["dockerfile"]
    rules = []
    ok, bad = rule_config_external(df)
    rules.append(("III 配置外置：环境相关值不得写进镜像", ok, bad))
    ok, bad = rule_no_secret(df)
    rules.append(("密钥不进镜像：不得 ENV/ARG/COPY 密钥", ok, bad))
    ok = project["deps_declared"]
    rules.append(("II 依赖显式声明：requirements.txt / package.json", ok,
                  [] if ok else ["缺少依赖清单文件"]))
    ok = project["log_to_stdout"]
    rules.append(("XI 日志当作事件流：写 stdout，不写容器内文件", ok,
                  [] if ok else ["日志写到容器可写层的文件"]))
    ok = not project["state_in_container"]
    rules.append(("VI 无状态进程：session/上传不得落在容器可写层", ok,
                  [] if ok else ["session 或上传文件写在容器本地目录"]))
    ok = project["port_from_env"]
    rules.append(("VII 端口绑定外置：端口由环境变量注入", ok,
                  [] if ok else ["端口硬编码在代码或 Dockerfile 里"]))
    return rules


def show(title, project):
    print("=== %s ===" % title)
    rules = check(project)
    passed = 0
    for name, ok, bad in rules:
        print("  [%s] %s" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", name))
        for b in bad:
            print("       违规: %s" % b)
        if ok:
            passed += 1
    rate = 100.0 * passed / len(rules)
    print("  合规项 = %d/%d，合规率 = %.1f%%" % (passed, len(rules), rate))
    print("  判定：可安全发布 = %s" % (passed == len(rules)))
    print()
    return rate
